settings.heading: Everything is poured to order
settings.text:
Espresso pulled from the same four origins we roast and sell as beans, plus the traditional preparations: buna brewed in a clay jebena, coffee with butter and salt, tej in a berele.

Nothing here is pre-made. If you order the ceremony, expect to stay a while.

settings.name: Espresso
settings.notes: Single-origin shots, macchiato, and milk drinks in a clear glass.

settings.name: Traditional
settings.notes: Buna as it is brewed at home: black, spiced, or with butter and salt.

settings.name: Iced
settings.notes: Harar steeped eighteen hours, and espresso over ice with honey.

settings.name: Tea
settings.notes: Honey mead with gesho, and bold fresh ginger with lemon.
